question_record.context: As part of a security incident, a suspicious system hardware discovery was detected on 2024-07-04. The file `svchost.exe` was observed running on host `mb-winclient` by user accounts including `bjenkins` and `pwilson`. This was followed by an internal phishing campaign where a user was observed to have sent phishing emails from this device to recipients inside the organization. This internal phishing activity was flagged by Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
question_record.question: What is the primary email address of the mailbox to which emails containing malicious URL were delivered and later removed?
solution: A user with SID `S-1-5-21-561436748-3867387497-1732241745-3701` engaged in suspicious system hardware discovery.
The user with SID `S-1-5-11-7842151660-4834030208-105586563-1139` sent phishing emails internally within the organization, indicating a potential account compromise.
An email containing a malicious URL was sent to the mailbox with the primary address `santiago@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co`, and it was later removed.
